rules.statement: Give the primary message the strongest visual emphasis; supporting evidence and action follow.

rules.statement: Review copy at actual displayed size, crop and viewing distance.

rules.statement: Keep deliberate space between text, marks and subject; protect critical content from edges and overlays.

rules.statement: Choose message depth to match dwell time and user intent.
rules.rationale: A small banner or moving-traffic billboard has less reading opportunity than a brochure.
rules.limits: No universal word budget; required qualifiers must survive.

rules.statement: Make visual and copy support the same truthful proposition.
rules.rationale: Contradictory imagery can create an unsupported impression.
rules.limits: Catalog and responsive assets may forbid or discourage added text; brand text rules cannot override that.

rules.statement: Use a coherent reading sequence, language direction and sequence of cards/pages.
rules.rationale: The offer, support and action should be understandable in order.
rules.limits: Cards may reorder; essential qualification must not rely on an unseen later card.

rules.statement: Verify every baked word, numeral, accent and qualifier in the actual generated artwork.
rules.rationale: Image generation can misspell or omit exact text.
rules.limits: OCR is a candidate check, not proof; semantic/visual review required.

rules.statement: State what happened and what the recipient can do, with sufficient context and restrained urgency.
rules.rationale: A system notification competes with personal utility signals; decorative copy can hide useful meaning.
rules.limits: OS/provider display and accessibility remain conditional; no universal title/body budget.
